sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the head of a family-owned craft store who took a fight over conservative values all the way to the Supreme
sentences.zh: 今天，一位家族式工艺品店的负责人将一场关于保守价值观的斗争一直打到了最高

sentences.en: Court.
sentences.zh: 法院。

sentences.en: A doctor in coal country whose patients hate Obamacare but may need it moSt. A sheriff on the Mexican border where illegal immigration is part of the landscape.
sentences.zh: 煤炭之乡的一位医生，他的患者讨厌奥巴马医改，但又最需要它。墨西哥边境的一位警长，那里的非法移民已成风景的一部分。

sentences.en: Two Republicans and one independent.
sentences.zh: 两位共和党人，一位独立人士。

sentences.en: Each of them told us how a major moment in this new administration connected to their own lives.
sentences.zh: 他们每个人都向我们讲述了新政府执政期间的一个重大时刻是如何与他们自己的生活联系在一起的。

sentences.en: As we approach the president's first 100 days in office, we hear from them again.
sentences.zh: 随着总统上任前100天的临近，我们再次倾听他们的心声。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, April 27th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月27日，星期四。

sentences.en: 100 days.
It's undeniably an arbitrary number.
sentences.zh: 这不可否认是一个随意的数字。

sentences.en: And it's not very much time.
sentences.zh: 而且时间并不算长。

sentences.en: But a lot has happened.
sentences.zh: 但发生了很多事情。

sentences.en: All right, we're going to sign three memoranduMs. The first one is withdrawal of the United States from the Trans-Pacific Partnership.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们要签署三份备忘录。第一份是美国退出跨太平洋伙伴关系协定。

sentences.en: Everyone knows what that means, right?
sentences.zh: 大家都知道这意味着什么，对吧？

sentences.en: We've been talking about this for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我们已经讨论了很长时间。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: The United States of America gets back control of its borders, gets back its borders.
sentences.zh: 美利坚合众国重新掌握了其边境的控制权，收回了边境。

sentences.en: I'm establishing new vetting measures to keep radical Islamic terrorists out of the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 我正在建立新的审查措施，将激进的伊斯兰恐怖分子拒于美利坚合众国之外。

sentences.en: We don't want them here.
sentences.zh: 我们不欢迎他们来到这里。

sentences.en: And I got it done in the first 100 days.
sentences.zh: 我在前100天内完成了它。

sentences.en: That's even nice.
sentences.zh: 这甚至很好。

sentences.en: You think that's easy?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这很容易吗？

sentences.en: Then, on day nine of his presidency, Donald Trump gave conservatives what they had wanted most from him, a pick to fill the seat left open by
sentences.zh: 然后，在唐纳德·特朗普总统任期的第九天，他满足了保守派对他的最大期望——挑选人选来填补因

sentences.en: Justice Antonin Scalia's death.
sentences.zh: 大法官安东尼·斯卡利亚逝世而空出的席位。

sentences.en: Today, I am keeping another promise to the American people by nominating Judge Neil Gorsuch of the United States Supreme Court to be of the United States
sentences.zh: 今天，我通过提名美国最高法院法官尼尔·戈萨奇担任美国最高法院大法官，

sentences.en: Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 再次兑现了我对美国人民的承诺。

sentences.en: Mr. Green, it's Michael Barbaro from The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 格林先生，我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: How can I help you?
sentences.zh: 我能帮您什么？

sentences.en: The next morning, The Daily launched with its first episode.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，《每日新闻》播出了它的第一集。

sentences.en: And on that show, we met David Green, the CEO of Hobby Lobby, a chain of craft stores.
sentences.zh: 在那期节目中，我们采访了工艺品连锁店好必来（Hobby Lobby）的首席执行官大卫·格林。

sentences.en: Where am I reaching you?
sentences.zh: 你在哪里接听电话？

sentences.en: Are you in transit?
sentences.zh: 你在路上吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I'm in my car, but I'm in Oklahoma City.
sentences.zh: 是的，我在车里，但我现在在俄克拉荷马城。

sentences.en: On business?
sentences.zh: 出差吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Going to one of the stores.
sentences.zh: 正要去其中一家店。

sentences.en: He had supported President Trump for one reason, putting a conservative judge on the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 他支持特朗普总统只有一个原因：将一名保守派法官送上最高法院。

sentences.en: He himself had recently taken a case to that court during President Obama's time in office.
sentences.zh: 在奥巴马总统执政期间，他本人最近刚刚将一桩案件打到了该法院。

sentences.en: Justices just issued a landmark ruling on religious freedom and Obamacare.
sentences.zh: 大法官们刚刚对宗教自由和奥巴马医改做出了一项具有里程碑意义的裁决。

sentences.en: The family-owned craft store chain Hobby Lobby claimed it shouldn't have to pay for contraception for its employees as part of the Affordable Care Act.
sentences.zh: 家族式工艺品连锁店好必来声称，作为《平价医疗法案》的一部分，它不应该为员工支付避孕费用。

sentences.en: They said it would violate the company's religious beliefs, and today, the justices agreed.
sentences.zh: 他们表示这会违背公司的宗教信仰，而今天，大法官们表示赞同。

sentences.en: So we had to sue the government or take life.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要么起诉政府，要么放弃生命。

sentences.en: That was our two choices.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的两种选择。

sentences.en: And so we didn't want to sue our government.
sentences.zh: 因此我们不想起诉我们的政府。

sentences.en: We love this country.
sentences.zh: 我们热爱这个国家。

sentences.en: But we were forced to do that, and now we're back to running our business.
sentences.zh: 但我们被迫这样做，现在我们又回去经营我们的业务了。

sentences.en: As Green's case made its way up to the Supreme Court, one of the appeals court judges who sided with Hobby Lobby was Neil Gorsuch.
sentences.zh: 随着格林一案层层上诉至最高法院，支持好必来的上诉法院法官之一就是尼尔·戈萨奇。

sentences.en: So Judge Neil Gorsuch was confirmed by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，尼尔·戈萨奇法官获得了美国

sentences.en: Senate, and now he's on the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 参议院的确认，现在他成为了最高法院大法官。

sentences.en: How did that make you feel when that happened?
sentences.zh: 当这发生时，你作何感想？

sentences.en: Well, obviously, we were very excited about it because this is our big issue.
sentences.zh: 嗯，显然我们对此非常兴奋，因为这是我们的重大议题。

sentences.en: We feel like he will be a proponent to religious liberties.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得他将成为宗教自由的支持者。

sentences.en: So obviously, it was very good for us.
sentences.zh: 所以显而易见，这对我们非常有利。

sentences.en: This week, David Green came into our studio in New York.
sentences.zh: 本周，大卫·格林来到了我们在纽约的工作室。

sentences.en: And so this, for you, is an improvement over the last president, President Obama.
sentences.zh: 所以对你来说，这比上一任总统奥巴马是一个进步。

sentences.en: Well, certainly, we lost a good judge that supported religious liberties, and we sort of replaced him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然，我们失去了一位支持宗教自由的好法官，而我们某种程度上算是替换了他。

sentences.en: So we're back to even right now.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在又回到了平局状态。

sentences.en: Judge Cleo.
sentences.zh: 克莱奥法官。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So we're, you know, for us, we don't understand how that we had a 5-4.
sentences.zh: 所以我们，你知道，对于我们来说，我们不明白怎么会是5比4。

sentences.en: We can't understand why it's not a 9-0 in favor of our case.
sentences.zh: 我们无法理解为什么支持我们案件的不是9比0。

sentences.en: It's beyond our comprehension how a judge could tell us that we're forced to take life.
sentences.zh: 法官怎么能告诉我们说我们被迫放弃生命，这超出了我们的理解范围。

sentences.en: It's beyond our comprehension, to be honest with you, about how someone could vote against religious liberties.
sentences.zh: 说实话，怎么会有人投票反对宗教自由，这超出了我们的理解范围。

sentences.en: You happen to operate a really large business in Hobby Lobby, which gives you a pretty unique
sentences.zh: 你在好必来经营着一家规模非常大的企业，这让你对这个白宫以及这个

sentences.en: perspective on how this White House and how this presidency are managing the economy.
sentences.zh: 总统职位如何管理经济拥有了非常独特的视角。

sentences.en: What would you say is your take on how they're doing in managing the economy?
sentences.zh: 你认为他们在管理经济方面做得怎么样？

sentences.en: Well, I know that what they're going to do is more in front of us than has happened yet.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我知道他们要做的事情更多还在后头，尚未发生。

sentences.en: You know, the tax breaks that's supposed to be coming along.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那些据说即将出台的税收减免。

sentences.en: And so I think a lot of the things that's going to happen has not happened yet, and we'll see if they do.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为许多将会发生的事情还没有发生，我们要拭目以待。

sentences.en: Of course, I'm just as concerned about our debt as I am the amount of taxes I pay.
sentences.zh: 当然，我对我们的债务的关心程度不亚于我缴纳的税款数额。

sentences.en: So it's not a big issue for me, the taxes I can pay a little more or a little less, and I'm good.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是个大问题对我而言，我多交或少交一点税都可以，我很好。

sentences.en: But one of my greater concerns is that is our debt that we're leaving to our children.
sentences.zh: 但我更担忧的事情之一是我们留给子孙后代的债务。

sentences.en: Would a corporate tax break on the order of what President Trump is proposing from 35% to 15% that's really substantial.
sentences.zh: 如果按照特朗普总统提出的将企业税从35%降至15%的规模进行税收减免，那真的很可观。

sentences.en: Does it worry you that that might increase the national debt?
sentences.zh: 这会不会增加国家债务让你感到担忧？

sentences.en: It does.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It does.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Is there going to be enough business positive to offset that?
sentences.zh: 会有足够的对商业有利的因素来抵消这一点吗？

sentences.en: It seems like that that's a little bit scary for me.
sentences.zh: 在我看来这似乎有点让人害怕。

sentences.en: In our original interview, Mr. Green, you expressed some skepticism that we would publish what you had
sentences.zh: 在我们最初的采访中，格林先生，你对我们是否会发表你关于好必来、

sentences.en: told us about Hobby Lobby, about the kinds of health care and contraception that it provided, and your whole approach to women's health care.
sentences.zh: 关于它提供的医疗保健和避孕服务种类以及你对女性医疗保健整体方法的看法表达了一些怀疑。

sentences.en: And I sense that you felt that you weren't being heard.
sentences.zh: 我感觉到你觉得自己没有被倾听。

sentences.en: And that maybe there were a number of voters who felt that same way.
sentences.zh: 也许有许多选民也有同样的感受。

sentences.en: Now that Donald Trump is our president, do you feel more heard?
sentences.zh: 既然唐纳德·特朗普是我们的总统，你觉得自己更受倾听了吗？

sentences.en: My subject lately has not been in the news media.
sentences.zh: 我最近的话题没有出现在新闻媒体上。

sentences.en: Of course, we have been mentioned because of our case, because of Gorsuch.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们因为我们的案件、因为戈萨奇而被提及。

sentences.en: But you still don't hear anything that would be positive about Hobby Lobby.
sentences.zh: 但你仍然听不到任何关于好必来的正面消息。

sentences.en: We're basically individuals that do not like women because of our stance on not providing pills, for instance, and drugs that would take life.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上被视为厌恶女性的人，因为我们在不提供避孕药等会夺走生命的药物这一问题上的立场。

sentences.en: Finally, on this, President Trump campaigned on a message of change, really big change in the United
sentences.zh: 最后，关于这一点，特朗普总统是以变革的信息进行竞选的，即美国将发生真正的巨大

sentences.en: States.
sentences.zh: 变革。

sentences.en: And now that it's been 100 days, which is not a huge amount of time, but it's a meaningful amount of time.
sentences.zh: 现在已经过去了100天，虽然这不是一个极长的时间，但它是一个有意义的时间长度。

sentences.en: How has this presidency so far changed either your life or your work?
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，这个总统职位是如何改变你的生活或工作的？

sentences.en: You know, from my work and my life personally, directly, I haven't seen a lot of things that would change other than the fact of the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 你知道，从我个人和直接的工作与生活来看，除了最高法院这件事之外，我没有看到很多会改变的事情。

sentences.en: And that is a big deal for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我很重要。

sentences.en: And so other than that, I haven't seen a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以除此之外，我没看到太多变化。

sentences.en: I just think 100 days isn't asking a lot from a president to do something that's very, very significant.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，要求一个总统在100天内做出非常非常重大的事情并不算过分。

sentences.en: And I believe that in our prayer is that he'll do a good job coming forward.
sentences.zh: 我相信，我们的祈祷是他在未来能做好工作。

sentences.en: I did have a little bit of time to talk to him at one time.
sentences.zh: 我有过一点时间跟他交谈过一次。

sentences.en: Did you?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I said that you're not going to make America great without God.
sentences.zh: 我对他说，没有上帝，你就不可能让美国再次伟大。

sentences.en: You know, this country started on a basis of biblical principles.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这个国家是建立在圣经原则的基础上的。

sentences.en: And so that's why on our coins, it says, in God, we truSt. And I wonder if we're trusting God anymore to help us and guide us.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是为什么我们的硬币上写着“我们信仰上帝”。我想知道我们是否还在信仰上帝来帮助和指导我们。

sentences.en: And so prayer and faith is something that I think has to be part of the equation if we see America great again.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为祈祷和信仰必须成为重振美国的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: What did President Trump say in response to that?
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统对此作何回应？

sentences.en: Well, I don't know that he, it was kind of a conversation that went pretty faSt. And I don't know that I recall something especially from that particular comment.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道他，那是一场进展相当快的对话。我不记得对那个特定评论有什么特别的回忆了。

sentences.en: So he didn't meaningfully respond in the moment?
sentences.zh: 所以他当时没有作出有意义的回应？

sentences.en: No, but he got the message that we're not going to change this company.
sentences.zh: 没有，但他收到了这样的信息：我们不会改变这家公司。

sentences.en: And it will not be great without going back to principles that's in the scriptures.
sentences.zh: 如果不回到经文中的原则，它就不会伟大。

sentences.en: Three weeks after Gorsuch's nomination, on February 21St...
sentences.zh: 在戈萨奇被提名三周后的2月21日……

sentences.en: This morning, Secretary Kelly and the Department of Homeland Security released memos regarding the
sentences.zh: 今天早上，凯利部长和国土安全部发布了关于实施旨在保护国土的总统两项行政命令的

sentences.en: implementation of two of the president's executive orders that are designed to protect the homeland.
sentences.zh: 备忘录。

sentences.en: The Trump administration announced a plan to unleash the full force of the federal government to find, arrest, and deport immigrants in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府宣布了一项计划，动用联邦政府的全部力量来搜寻、逮捕和驱逐在美国

sentences.en: illegally, regardless of whether or not they had committed serious crimes.
sentences.zh: 非法的移民，无论他们是否犯过严重罪行。

sentences.en: Perhaps most critically, the president is empowering DHS to carry out the immigration laws currently on the books.
sentences.zh: 也许最关键的是，总统正在授权国土安全部执行现行的移民法律。

sentences.en: As part of that, President Trump asked local law enforcement to work with federal immigration agents.
sentences.zh: 作为其中的一部分，特朗普总统要求地方执法部门与联邦移民特工合作。

sentences.en: I just don't have a lot of deputies right now sitting around wondering what to do.
sentences.zh: 我手头实在没有一大堆副警长闲着没事在想该做什么。

sentences.en: I know it's hard to imagine from where you're at, but my county is 9,200 square miles.
sentences.zh: 我知道从你们的角度很难想象，但我的县有9200平方英里。

sentences.en: It has a population of about a million people.
sentences.zh: 它的人口大约有一百万。

sentences.en: So to provide traditional law enforcement service to an area that is larger than some states is a very big challenge.
sentences.zh: 因此，为面积比某些州还要大的地区提供传统的执法服务是一个巨大的挑战。

sentences.en: And I simply don't have excess capacity to engage in proactive federal immigration enforcement.
sentences.zh: 我根本没有多余的能力去参与主动的联邦移民执法。

sentences.en: That's when we met Mark Napier, the Republican sheriff of Pima County, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我们遇到了亚利桑那州皮马县的共和党警长马克·纳普尔。

sentences.en: It shares 125 miles of border with Mexico.
sentences.zh: 它与墨西哥共享125英里的边境。

sentences.en: We also checked back in with him this week.
sentences.zh: 本周我们也对他进行了回访。

sentences.en: Sheriff, from your perspective, as a sheriff in a border county, what's happened with immigration since the president became the president and announced this more aggressive plan?
sentences.zh: 警长，从你的角度来看，作为一名边境县的警长，自从总统当选并宣布这项更具攻击性的计划以来，移民情况发生了什么变化？

sentences.en: Well, we've certainly, at least according to the Border Patrol, seen a decline in the volume of illegal entry into this country.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们确实看到，至少根据边境巡逻队的说法，非法进入这个国家的客流量有所下降。

sentences.en: But the thing that's a disadvantage would be that we've seen a decline in people crossing the border for transnational trade.
sentences.zh: 但不利的一面是，我们看到跨国贸易的越境人数有所下降。

sentences.en: And that's very important to our state.
sentences.zh: 这对于我们州非常重要。

sentences.en: It's about a $9 billion industry to the state of Arizona.
sentences.zh: 这对亚利桑那州来说是一个大约90亿美元的产业。

sentences.en: And when people feel uncertain or anxious about coming across the border, even to engage in legal commerce, that has a stifling effect on that part of our economy.
sentences.zh: 当人们对过境感到不确定或焦虑时，哪怕是为了从事合法的商业活动，这也会对我们经济的那一部分产生压制效应。

sentences.en: This is really surprising to me.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到非常惊讶。

sentences.en: Are you saying that legal crossings have declined as well as illegal crossings?
sentences.zh: 你是说合法越境和非法越境一样都有所下降吗？

sentences.en: Why would legal crossings decline?
sentences.zh: 为什么合法越境会下降？

sentences.en: Well, it's simply because there's just this climate of uncertainty about how they'll be treated.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这纯粹是因为有一种关于他们会受到如何对待的不确定氛围。

sentences.en: You know, about how they may be approached by law enforcement, by federal authorities.
sentences.zh: 你知道，关于执法人员、联邦当局会如何接近他们。

sentences.en: People have this fear of this new climate of how people are perceived that are not U.S.
sentences.zh: 人们对这种关于如何看待非美国

sentences.en: citizens.
sentences.zh: 公民的全新气候有一种恐惧感。

sentences.en: Let's get back to illegal crossings and the decline there.
sentences.zh: 我们先回到非法越境以及那里的下降趋势上来。

sentences.en: I think I have an understanding of why that's gone down.
sentences.zh: 我想我大致理解为什么这个数字下降了。

sentences.en: But since you're there and you're seeing it, why do you think that the illegal crossings have declined?
sentences.zh: 但既然你身处一线并亲眼目睹，你认为非法越境减少的原因是什么？

sentences.en: Well, there's certainly a ramped up effort on the part of the federal authorities to be more concentrated in their efforts.
sentences.zh: 嗯，联邦当局确实加大了力度，使他们的行动更加集中。

sentences.en: I think the prior administration probably did, to a large extent, handcuff them.
sentences.zh: 我认为上一届政府在很大程度上可能束缚了他们的手脚。

sentences.en: And they were kind of dissuaded from being proactive.
sentences.zh: 他们被某种程度上劝阻，不敢采取主动行动。

sentences.en: I think now the idea is that they'll be much more proactive.
sentences.zh: 我想现在的想法是，他们会采取更多的主动。

sentences.en: And to some, that may dissuade them from coming across the border.
sentences.zh: 对某些人来说，这可能会打消他们过境的念头。

sentences.en: Sheriff, you're in law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 警长，你是执法人员。

sentences.en: And if you're somebody, and you don't have to be a sheriff to feel this way, but if you're somebody who believes that the United States should enforce its immigration
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个人，而且你不必非得是个警长才会有这种感觉，但如果你是一个认为美国应该执行其移民

sentences.en: laws, it sounds like President Trump's plan and strategy are working.
sentences.zh: 法律的人，这听起来像是特朗普总统的计划和策略正在起作用。

sentences.en: Well, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道。

sentences.en: It's really hard to define what working means.
sentences.zh: 要给“起作用”下一个定义真的很难。

sentences.en: Are we dissuading people coming here for, you know, arguably a better life from crossing the border?
sentences.zh: 我们是在劝阻那些为了，你知道的，可以说是更好的生活而来到这里的人越过边境吗？

sentences.en: And, you know, it'll probably be in the high 90s here in Arizona today.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，亚利桑那州今天的气温可能会高达90多度（华氏度）。

sentences.en: And I don't want people dying in the deserts of the western part of my county.
sentences.zh: 我不想看到有人死在我郡西部的沙漠里。

sentences.en: That's a human rights tragedy.
sentences.zh: 那是一场人权悲剧。

sentences.en: You know, I would ask my Republican brethren, you know, that decry this.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我要问问我那些对此进行谴责的共和党同僚们，你知道的。

sentences.en: If your family were impoverished, if your family were in danger, if your family were in need, what would you not do to protect them, to give them a better life?
sentences.zh: 如果你的家庭陷于贫困，如果你的家庭处于危险之中，如果你的家庭急需帮助，为了保护他们，为了给他们更好的生活，你有什么事是做不出来的？

sentences.en: And they say, I would do anything.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，我什么都愿意做。

sentences.en: I think that when we talk about securing the border, I would like to secure the border in a way that completely dissuades people from making that journey.
sentences.zh: 我认为当我们谈论确保边境安全时，我希望以一种能彻底打消人们踏上这段旅程念头的方式来确保边境安全。

sentences.en: And I understand the need to come here for a better life.
sentences.zh: 我理解为了更好的生活而来到这里的需求。

sentences.en: But let's fix the immigration system so people can do that legally in a way that makes sense and is somewhat expeditious.
sentences.zh: 但让我们修复移民系统，以便人们能够以合理且相对迅速的方式合法地做到这一点。

sentences.en: Sheriff, would the wall that President Trump is proposing for the southern border, including in your part of Arizona, would it do the things that you're talking about here?
sentences.zh: 警长，特朗普总统提议在南部边境修建的墙，包括在你所在的亚利桑那州部分地区，它能实现你刚才所说的那些效果吗？

sentences.en: Well, you'd have to have to argue that it's a feasible proposition to begin with.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你首先得证明这是一个可行的方案。

sentences.en: And I'm not sure that I subscribe to it.
sentences.zh: 我不敢确定我是否赞同这一点。

sentences.en: I think it's kind of a medieval solution to a moderate problem.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对于一个温和的问题来说，是一种中世纪式的解决方案。

sentences.en: I mean, 10,000 years ago, we were building walls around things.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在一万年前，我们就在各种东西周围筑墙了。

sentences.en: And here we are in
sentences.zh: 而我们现在却身处

sentences.en: And this is the best idea we can come up with.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们能想出的最好的主意。

sentences.en: There are all other ways that we could secure the border at a lower cost point and probably more effectively.
sentences.zh: 还有各种其他的方法，我们可以用更低的成本，而且可能更有效地保障边境安全。

sentences.en: Are there places where physical barriers make sense?
sentences.zh: 有没有实体屏障有意义的地方？

sentences.en: Absolutely, there are.
sentences.zh: 当然有，确实有。

sentences.en: But there are places that are very remote in my county that if we decided to build a wall there at 30 feet high, we don't have the infrastructure there
sentences.zh: 但在我郡有一些非常偏远的地方，如果我们决定在那里修建一道30英尺高的墙，我们根本没有基础设施

sentences.en: to get the materials to the site to build the wall.
sentences.zh: 把材料运到施工地点去建墙。

sentences.en: If some of that money were redirected to local law enforcement, we could get results.
sentences.zh: 如果把其中一部分资金重新分配给地方执法部门，我们就能取得成效。

sentences.en: If the Trump administration gave me $5 million right now, I could produce results that would make my county a safer place with a small, small fraction of what
sentences.zh: 如果特朗普政府现在给我500万美元，我可以用只占我们将在实体屏障上花费的

sentences.en: we'll spend on a physical barrier.
sentences.zh: 极小一小部分的资金，取得让我的郡变得更安全的成效。

sentences.en: Sheriff, has there been a story or a moment in these first hundred days of President Trump's time in the White House that captures for you the way that policy in
sentences.zh: 警长，在特朗普总统入主白宫的前一百天里，有没有哪个故事或时刻，让你觉得华盛顿的政策

sentences.en: Washington is playing out in your county?
sentences.zh: 正在你的郡内真实上演？

sentences.en: No, we've not fundamentally changed the way that we do business at all.
sentences.zh: 没有，我们开展业务的方式根本没有发生根本性的改变。

sentences.en: It's not trickled down to a local level.
sentences.zh: 它并没有渗透到地方层面。

sentences.en: I think, you know, 100 days is not a long time for any administration.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道的，100天对任何政府来说都不是一段很长的时间。

sentences.en: I'm just four months into my administration and we tend to be very impatient.
sentences.zh: 我上任才四个月，而我们往往非常没有耐心。

sentences.en: We want things to happen very quickly.
sentences.zh: 我们希望事情发生得非常快。

sentences.en: And I just don't see a quick solution to this problem that really has festered for decades.
sentences.zh: 而我只是看不到这个已经恶化了几十年的问题能有什么快速的解决方案。

sentences.en: Then seven weeks into the president's term, on March 6th,
sentences.zh: 然后在总统任期开始七周后，即3月6日，

sentences.en: Republicans in the House announced their new health care plan.
sentences.zh: 众议院的共和党人公布了他们的新医疗保健计划。

sentences.en: First of all, I would like to walk you through exactly what the American Health Care Act is and how important it is to repeal and replace
sentences.zh: 首先，我想带大家详细了解一下《美国医疗法案》，以及废除和取代

sentences.en: Obamacare, not just because the law is collapsing, but because the law is going to get even worse if we do nothing.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马医改有多么重要，不仅是因为该法律正在崩溃，还因为如果我们什么都不做，该法律会变得更糟。

sentences.en: This too was the fulfillment of one of President Trump's big promises as a candidate.
sentences.zh: 这也是兑现特朗普总统作为候选人时的重大承诺之一。

sentences.en: On my first day in office, I am going to ask Congress to send me a bill to immediately repeal and replace, I just said it, Obamacare.
sentences.zh: 在我上任的第一天，我将要求国会向我提交一份法案，以立即废除并取代，我刚才说过了，奥巴马医改。

sentences.en: I think there's a withdrawal from 20 to 25 percent of our patients.
sentences.zh: 我认为有20%到25%的患者退出了。

sentences.en: A number of those will die.
sentences.zh: 其中相当一部分人会死去。

sentences.en: You know, the people on the edge.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那些处境边缘的人。

sentences.en: I think the lack of affordable health care to the population I care for with a chronic disease they have will be devastating.
sentences.zh: 我认为，对于我所照顾的患有慢性病的群体来说，缺乏负担得起的医疗保健将是毁灭性的。

sentences.en: This was Dr. Mitch Jake's reaction right after the Republican health care plan had been announced.
sentences.zh: 这是米奇·杰克斯（Mitch Jake）医生在共和党医改计划公布后不久的反应。

sentences.en: He works at a health care clinic in West Virginia where many of his patients had benefited from Obamacare, but voted for President Trump and for the repeal of Obamacare.
sentences.zh: 他在西弗吉尼亚州的一个医疗诊所工作，他的许多患者曾受益于奥巴马医改，但却投票支持了特朗普总统以及废除奥巴马医改。

sentences.en: I called him back.
sentences.zh: 我给他回了电话。

sentences.en: So that Republican plan failed.
sentences.zh: 所以那个共和党计划失败了。

sentences.en: What was your reaction when it collapsed and failed?
sentences.zh: 当它崩溃并失败时，你的反应是什么？

sentences.en: I think it'll be back.
sentences.zh: 我想它还会卷土重来的。

sentences.en: I think something will be back, but for my patients' sake, it was a great relief.
sentences.zh: 我想会有某种计划卷土重来的，但为了我的病人们好，这算是一个巨大的解脱。

sentences.en: We see so many patients that have very poor health care, and at least in our state, if you work, you don't necessarily get health insurance.
sentences.zh: 我们看到如此多的病人医疗条件非常糟糕，至少在我们州，如果你工作，并不一定能获得医疗保险。

sentences.en: So many people work very hard.
sentences.zh: 有太多的人工作非常努力。

sentences.en: If they were to lose their health insurance, it would be devastating for them.
sentences.zh: 如果他们失去了医疗保险，对他们来说将是毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: So, Doctor, what did your patients think of the Republican plan, which, as we've said, would have
sentences.zh: 那么，医生，您的病人们对共和党计划有何看法？正如我们所说，该计划原本会

sentences.en: repealed the Affordable Care Act and replaced it with something very different that you had all these concerns about?
sentences.zh: 废除《平价医疗法案》，并将其替换为让你们所有人都有这些担忧的、非常不同的东西？

sentences.en: What did they think of it?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么看的？

sentences.en: I think when they realized it was going on, they were terrified, you know, that they could lose the
sentences.zh: 我想当他们意识到这一点时，他们吓坏了，你知道的，他们可能会失去

sentences.en: health care they had had, particularly for those individuals who were working and had income, but the
sentences.zh: 他们一直拥有的医疗保健，特别是对于那些有工作有收入但

sentences.en: cost of health care was very high, that if they'd lose their subsidies, they would not be able to afford health care.
sentences.zh: 医疗成本非常高、如果失去补贴就看不起病的个人而言。

sentences.en: And I think most of them were horrified that that could happen.
sentences.zh: 我想他们大多数人对这种事情可能发生感到惊恐万分。

sentences.en: And I've always tried to make sense of this.
sentences.zh: 我一直试图理解这一点。

sentences.en: I mean, how did some of these voters, and I recognize that a doctor doesn't necessarily talk politics with his patients, but how did those patients make
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，其中一些选民——我承认医生不一定会和患者谈论政治——但那些患者是如何理解

sentences.en: sense of how they had voted?
sentences.zh: 他们自己投出的那一票的？

sentences.en: You told me that this is a community, very bound up in the coal industry that voted heavily for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 你告诉我，这是一个深度绑定煤炭产业的社区，他们大量投票支持了唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: So what did your patients say about this health care plan that the president supported, and their anxiety that it might take away their health care?
sentences.zh: 那么你的病人们对这个总统支持的医改计划，以及它可能会剥夺他们医疗保险的焦虑是怎么说的呢？

sentences.en: Well, I think that Donald Trump offered patients who were down and out hope that things would change.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为唐纳德·特朗普给那些处于困境中的患者带来了事情会改变的希望。

sentences.en: I don't think most people understood the health care issue.
sentences.zh: 我认为大多数人并不理解医疗保健问题。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump had promised health care for everyone, and I think people believed him when he said that.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生曾承诺为每个人提供医疗保健，我想人们在他这么说时相信了他。

sentences.en: So finally, you know, we're talking because this presidency is reaching the 100-day mark, and this is a president who came into office promising change.
sentences.zh: 所以最后，你知道的，我们在进行交谈，因为这个总统任期即将迎来100天大关，而这是一位带着变革承诺上任的总统。

sentences.en: So has this presidency had any impact on your role as a physician in this community?
sentences.zh: 那么这个总统任期是否对你在这个社区中作为一名医生的角色产生了任何影响？

sentences.en: Has it changed anything?
sentences.zh: 它改变了什么吗？

sentences.en: Not yet.
sentences.zh: 还没有。

sentences.en: But health care is not an easy, does not have easy solutions.
sentences.zh: 但医疗保健不是一件简单的事，也没有简单的解决方案。

sentences.en: And I would much rather Congress take a long, hard look at fundamental changes to make health more affordable to everyone than to try to pass something quickly.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿国会花时间好好深入研究根本性变革，让每个人都更能负担得起医疗费用，也不愿试图仓促通过什么法案。

sentences.en: I want gradual evolution to better health care with carefully thought out plans that are not simply political strategies.
sentences.zh: 我希望通过经过深思熟虑、而不仅仅是政治策略的计划，循序渐进地演变出更好的医疗保健。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能查阅所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费体验《时报》一个月，甚至不需要输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: Three days before the 100-day mark,
sentences.zh: 在100天大关的三天前，

sentences.en: President Trump is proposing a plan to slash tax rates for individuals and businesses and radically reorder the tax code in a way that would significantly benefit the wealthy.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统提出了一项计划，旨在大幅削减个人和企业的税率，并彻底重组税法，这将使富人受益匪浅。

sentences.en: Among the key features outlined
sentences.zh: 首席经济顾问加里·科恩（Gary Cohn）于

sentences.en: Wednesday by Chief Economic Advisor Gary Cohn.
sentences.zh: 周三概述了其中的主要特点。

sentences.en: We are going to cut taxes and simplify the tax code by taking the current seven tax brackets we have today and reducing them to only three brackets.
sentences.zh: 我们将通过将我们今天现有的七个税级削减至仅三个税级，来削减税收并简化税法。

sentences.en: A 10% bracket, a 25% bracket, and a 35% bracket.
sentences.zh: 一个10%的税级，一个25%的税级，和一个35%的税级。

sentences.en: That would ease the tax burden for most Americans.
sentences.zh: 这将减轻大多数美国人的税收负担。

sentences.en: The plan would also cut the corporate tax rate from 35% to 15%.
sentences.zh: 该计划还将把公司税率从35%降至15%。

sentences.en: The plan is light on details and just a blueprint, meant to formally begin a push to get a tax overhaul done before the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 该计划缺乏细节，只是一份蓝图，旨在正式开始推动在年底前完成税制全面改革。

sentences.en: We have a once-in-a-generation opportunity to do something really big.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有几十年一遇的机遇来做一件真正大事。

sentences.en: President Trump has made tax reform a priority, and we have a Republican Congress that wants to get it done.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统将税制改革作为首要任务，我们拥有一个希望完成这项工作的共和党国会。

sentences.en: That also includes the resurrection of the Republican health care plan and the possible withdrawal of the
sentences.zh: 这也包括复活共和党医改计划以及美国可能退出

sentences.en: United States from the North American Free Trade Agreement, NAFTA.
sentences.zh: 《北美自由贸易协定》（NAFTA）。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》（The Daily）就到这里。

sentences.en: I'm Michael
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·

sentences.en: Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。
